test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Find the one which completes the series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dd4ae082011907e85da2a02629dec3d45ec04dcf4eee03e7e2000c0142b4fd7.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** The pattern is based on two changes — the **shading of concentric circles** and the **movement of the dot**.

So far, the shading alternates between the **middle circle → outer circle → middle circle**, so the next figure must have the **outer circle shaded black**.

At the same time, the dot alternates its position between **top-left → top-right → top-left**, so the next position will be **top-right**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b7ec57a05240489aa5ffe84c5119fb75546a2073e43adcac2d2e39f7f8935ed.png] 

Thus, the required figure must have the **outer circle shaded** and the **dot at the top-right**, maintaining both patterns.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
